exposure: Gestational age at elective caesarean section
cohort: Women with an elective caesarean section performed at gestational age >=37 weeks in Queen Elizabeth Hospital, Hong Kong, between 1 January 2016 and 31 December 2018
finding: Elective caesarean delivery at 37 weeks' gestation is associated with higher risks of respiratory distress syndrome and neonatal intensive care unit admission, compared with elective caesarean delivery at 39 weeks' gestation.
